"""Archive the two complete small exact inverse/adjoint/projector checks."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import time


def main():
    from flint import fmpq_mat
    output=Path('results/imaginary_adjoint_inverse_small_exact.json')
    if output.exists():raise FileExistsError('The exact synthetic audit is immutable')
    start=time.monotonic();test_path=Path('tests/test_imaginary_adjoint_inverse.py')
    helpers=runpy.run_path(str(test_path));cases=[]
    def matrix_record(A):return dict(shape=[A.nrows(),A.ncols()],entries=[str(v) for v in A.entries()])
    def matrix_digest(A):return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(matrix_record(A),separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
    for nonorthogonal in (False,True):
        model=helpers['fixture'](nonorthogonal)
        I=helpers['independent_original_imaginary_matrix'](model)
        left=helpers['columns_from_apply'](model.left_apply,92,42)
        right=helpers['columns_from_apply'](model.right_apply,42,92)
        row_identity=fmpq_mat(42,42,[int(i==j) for i in range(42) for j in range(42)])
        full_identity=fmpq_mat(92,92,[int(i==j) for i in range(92) for j in range(92)])
        N=full_identity-right*I
        checks=dict(left_inverse=left*I.transpose()==row_identity,
            explicit_adjoint_equals_transpose=right==left.transpose(),right_inverse=I*right==row_identity,
            projector_idempotent=N*N==N,projector_in_imaginary_kernel=I*N==fmpq_mat(42,92),
            constant_direction_preserved=all(N[i,0]==int(i==0) for i in range(92)))
        if not all(checks.values()):raise ArithmeticError('An exact full inverse/projector identity failed')
        cases.append(dict(M=7,L=2,nonorthogonal_T=nonorthogonal,source_physics_values_used=False,
            imaginary_shape=[42,92],imaginary_rank=I.rank(),projector_rank=N.rank(),checks=checks,
            T=matrix_record(model.op.T),W0=matrix_record(model.W0),kappa=[str(v) for v in model.kappa],
            selected_rows=model.selected,selected_inverse=matrix_record(model.U),row_labels=model.row_labels,
            matrix_sha256={name:matrix_digest(value) for name,value in [('I',I),('left',left),('right',right),('N',N)]}))
    paths=[Path(__file__),test_path,Path('src/smatrix_bootstrap/imaginary_adjoint_inverse.py'),
        Path('src/smatrix_bootstrap/imaginary_rank_residual.py')]
    sources={str(path):path.read_text() for path in paths}
    report=dict(schema='smatrix-imaginary-adjoint-inverse-small-exact-v1',status='passed',cases=cases,
        source_snapshot_utf8=sources,source_sha256={name:hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() for name,text in sources.items()},
        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,full_source_inverse_materialized=False,
        full_source_projector_materialized=False,new_physical_master_evaluations=0,
        remaining_real_target_rank_claim=False,scope='Complete exact rational synthetic algebra tests only.')
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed',cases=len(cases),elapsed_seconds=report['elapsed_seconds'],output=str(output))))


if __name__=='__main__':main()

import pytest

flint=pytest.importorskip('flint')
from flint import fmpq,fmpq_mat
from smatrix_bootstrap.imaginary_rank_residual import ImaginaryRankResidual
from smatrix_bootstrap.imaginary_adjoint_inverse import ExactImaginaryAdjointInverse


def fixture(nonorthogonal):
    M=7
    T=fmpq_mat(M,M,[int(i==j)+(int(j==i+1) if nonorthogonal else 0) for i in range(M) for j in range(M)])
    blocks=[];selectors=[]
    for j in range(M):
        indices=[(j+1)%M,(j+2)%M,(j+3)%M]
        W=fmpq_mat(M,3,[int(i==indices[k]) for i in range(M) for k in range(3)])
        blocks.append(T.transpose()*W);selectors.append(indices)
    op=ImaginaryRankResidual(blocks,T,1,selectors)
    reduced,rank=op.matrix().transpose().rref();assert rank==M
    selected=[next(j for j in range(reduced.ncols()) if reduced[i,j]) for i in range(rank)]
    inverse=op.matrix(selected).inv()
    W0=fmpq_mat(M,M,[fmpq(1,i+j+2) for i in range(M) for j in range(M)])
    kappa=[fmpq(j+5,3) for j in range(M)]
    return ExactImaginaryAdjointInverse(op,W0,kappa,selected,inverse)


def independent_original_imaginary_matrix(model):
    """Direct IS1 derivatives in raw coefficients; no inverse/reverse formulas."""
    M=model.M;rows=[];op=model.op
    for node,iso,ell in model.row_labels:
        u=[op.T[node,n] for n in range(M)]
        if ell==0:J=op.TT*fmpq_mat(M,1,[model.W0[n,node] for n in range(M)])
        else:
            column=0 if ell==2 else (1 if ell==1 else 2)
            J=fmpq_mat(M,1,[op.J[node][n,column] for n in range(M)])
        c0=fmpq(1,2) if ell==0 else 0
        a=[3*c0*x if iso==0 else 0 for x in u]
        b=[2*c0*x if iso in (0,2) else 0 for x in u]
        B=[2*(J[n,0]*u[m]+(3*J[m,0]*u[n] if iso==0 else 0))
           for n in range(M) for m in range(M)]
        sign=-1 if iso==1 else 1
        C=[sign*(2*J[n,0]*u[n] if n==m else J[n,0]*u[m]+J[m,0]*u[n])
           for n in range(M) for m in range(n,M)]
        rows.extend(model.kappa[node]*v for v in [0]+a+b+B+C)
    return fmpq_mat(model.row_count,model.coefficient_count,rows)


def columns_from_apply(function,input_count,output_count):
    cols=[function(fmpq_mat(input_count,1,[int(i==j) for i in range(input_count)])) for j in range(input_count)]
    return fmpq_mat(output_count,input_count,[cols[j][i,0] for i in range(output_count) for j in range(input_count)])


@pytest.mark.parametrize('nonorthogonal',[False,True])
def test_full_left_right_inverse_and_projector_in_exact_flat_pairings(nonorthogonal):
    model=fixture(nonorthogonal);I=independent_original_imaginary_matrix(model)
    left=columns_from_apply(model.left_apply,92,42)
    right=columns_from_apply(model.right_apply,42,92)
    row_identity=fmpq_mat(42,42,[int(i==j) for i in range(42) for j in range(42)])
    coefficient_identity=fmpq_mat(92,92,[int(i==j) for i in range(92) for j in range(92)])
    assert I.nrows()==42 and I.ncols()==92 and I.rank()==42
    assert left*I.transpose()==row_identity
    assert right==left.transpose() and I*right==row_identity
    N=coefficient_identity-right*I
    assert N*N==N and I*N==fmpq_mat(42,92) and N.rank()==50
    assert all(right[0,j]==0 for j in range(42))
    assert all(N[i,0]==int(i==0) for i in range(92))
    assert model.row_labels[:6]==[(0,0,0),(0,0,2),(0,1,1),(0,1,3),(0,2,0),(0,2,2)]

"""Exact rational implementation of the imaginary inverse formulas.

This validates the factorized apply/adjoint on small synthetic data. It does
not load analytic-source intervals, form a full-source projector, or replace
the exact selected-minor inverse by an approximate numerical inverse.
"""


def _column(A,j):
    from flint import fmpq_mat
    return fmpq_mat(A.nrows(),1,[A[i,j] for i in range(A.nrows())])


def _sym(A):return (A+A.transpose())/2


class ExactImaginaryAdjointInverse:
    """Euclidean flat-coefficient/physical-row left inverse and its adjoint."""
    def __init__(self,residual,W0,kappa,selected_rows,selected_inverse):
        from flint import fmpq_mat
        self.op=residual;self.M=residual.M;self.e=residual.e;self.L=self.e+1
        if type(residual.T)!=fmpq_mat or type(W0)!=fmpq_mat or type(selected_inverse)!=fmpq_mat:
            raise TypeError('This bounded helper accepts exact rational matrices only')
        if residual.o!=self.L or W0.nrows()!=self.M or W0.ncols()!=self.M:
            raise ValueError('Complete even/odd spin families and one S-wave column per node required')
        if len(kappa)!=self.M or any(x<=0 for x in kappa):raise ValueError('Positive physical row scales required')
        self.W0=W0;self.kappa=list(kappa);self.selected=list(selected_rows);self.U=selected_inverse
        n=residual.columns
        if len(self.selected)!=n or len(set(self.selected))!=n or self.U.nrows()!=n or self.U.ncols()!=n:
            raise ValueError('A complete square selected-minor inverse is required')
        identity=fmpq_mat(n,n,[int(i==j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n)])
        if self.U*residual.matrix(self.selected)!=identity:
            raise ValueError('The supplied selected-minor inverse is not exact')
        self.Tinv=residual.TinvT.transpose()
        self.local=[A*residual.TT for A in residual.A]
        self.coefficient_count=1+2*self.M+self.M**2+self.M*(self.M+1)//2
        self.row_labels=[(j,iso,2*k+int(iso==1)) for j in range(self.M) for iso in range(3) for k in range(self.L)]
        self.row_count=len(self.row_labels)

    def left_apply(self,r):
        """L_G r: arbitrary residual extension, exact on range(I_G^T)."""
        from flint import fmpq_mat
        M,e=self.M,self.e;op=self.op
        if type(r)!=fmpq_mat or r.nrows()!=self.coefficient_count or r.ncols()!=1:
            raise ValueError('Full exact flat coefficient residual required')
        at=1;ra=fmpq_mat(M,1,[r[at+i,0] for i in range(M)]);at+=M
        rb=fmpq_mat(M,1,[r[at+i,0] for i in range(M)]);at+=M
        rB=fmpq_mat(M,M,[r[at+i,0] for i in range(M*M)]);at+=M*M
        # Flat c_nm=2*C_nm offdiagonal: its dual embeds WITHOUT a half.
        rC=fmpq_mat(M,M)
        for i in range(M):
            for j in range(i,M):rC[i,j]=rC[j,i]=r[at,0];at+=1
        alpha0=2*op.TinvT*ra/3;beta0=op.TinvT*rb
        P0=fmpq_mat(M,M,[self.W0[i,j]*alpha0[j,0] for i in range(M) for j in range(M)])
        Q0=fmpq_mat(M,M,[self.W0[i,j]*beta0[j,0] for i in range(M) for j in range(M)])
        A=op.TinvT*rB*self.Tinv/2-3*P0.transpose()-Q0
        H=op.TinvT*rC*self.Tinv/2-_sym(Q0)
        membership=[];signedA=fmpq_mat(M,M)
        for j in range(M):
            column=_column(A,j);part=op.membership[j]*column/3
            membership.extend(part[i,0] for i in range(M))
            signed=op.signed[j]*column
            for i in range(M):signedA[i,j]=signed[i,0]
        sym_rhs=H-_sym(signedA)
        rhs=membership+[sym_rhs[i,j] for i,j in op.sym_pairs]
        alpha=self.U*fmpq_mat(op.columns,1,[rhs[i] for i in self.selected])
        P=fmpq_mat(M,M)
        for j in range(M):
            column=op.E[j]*fmpq_mat(e,1,[alpha[j*e+a,0] for a in range(e)])
            for i in range(M):P[i,j]=column[i,0]
        result=[]
        for j in range(M):
            z=self.local[j]*(_column(A,j)-3*_column(P.transpose(),j))
            aa=[alpha0[j,0]]+[alpha[j*e+a,0] for a in range(e)]
            bb=[beta0[j,0]]+[z[a,0] for a in range(e)]
            gg=[z[e+a,0] for a in range(self.L)]
            result.extend(x/self.kappa[j] for x in aa)
            result.extend(x/self.kappa[j] for x in gg)
            result.extend((bb[a]-aa[a])/self.kappa[j] for a in range(self.L))
        return fmpq_mat(self.row_count,1,result)

    def right_apply(self,g):
        """R_G g from explicit reverse formulas, independently of left_apply."""
        from flint import fmpq_mat
        M,e,L=self.M,self.e,self.L;op=self.op
        if type(g)!=fmpq_mat or g.nrows()!=self.row_count or g.ncols()!=1:
            raise ValueError('All exact node-major physical row targets required')
        d=[];ee=[];vv=[]
        for j in range(M):
            start=j*3*L;kappa=self.kappa[j]
            d.append([(g[start+a,0]-g[start+2*L+a,0])/kappa for a in range(L)])
            ee.append([g[start+2*L+a,0]/kappa for a in range(L)])
            vv.append([g[start+L+a,0]/kappa for a in range(L)])
        Ybar=fmpq_mat(M,M)
        for j in range(M):
            column=self.local[j].transpose()*fmpq_mat(e+L,1,ee[j][1:]+vv[j])
            for i in range(M):Ybar[i,j]=column[i,0]
        abar=[]
        for j in range(M):
            correction=-3*op.E[j].transpose()*_column(Ybar.transpose(),j)
            abar.extend(d[j][a+1]+correction[a,0] for a in range(e))
        selected_bar=self.U.transpose()*fmpq_mat(op.columns,1,abar)
        rhsbar=[selected_bar[0,0]*0]*op.rows
        for i,row in enumerate(self.selected):rhsbar[row]=selected_bar[i,0]
        V=fmpq_mat(M,M)
        for k,(i,j) in enumerate(op.sym_pairs):
            value=rhsbar[M*M+k]
            if i==j:V[i,j]=value
            else:V[i,j]=V[j,i]=value/2
        Abar=fmpq_mat(Ybar)
        for j in range(M):
            u=fmpq_mat(M,1,rhsbar[j*M:(j+1)*M])
            correction=op.membership[j].transpose()*u/3-op.signed[j].transpose()*_column(V,j)
            for i in range(M):Abar[i,j]+=correction[i,0]
        a0bar=[];b0bar=[]
        for j in range(M):
            a0bar.append(d[j][0]-3*sum(self.W0[i,j]*Abar[j,i] for i in range(M)))
            b0bar.append(ee[j][0]-sum(self.W0[i,j]*(Abar[i,j]+V[i,j]) for i in range(M)))
        a=2*self.Tinv*fmpq_mat(M,1,a0bar)/3;b=self.Tinv*fmpq_mat(M,1,b0bar)
        B=self.Tinv*Abar*op.TinvT/2;C=self.Tinv*V*op.TinvT/2
        flat=[0]+[a[i,0] for i in range(M)]+[b[i,0] for i in range(M)]
        flat.extend(B[i,j] for i in range(M) for j in range(M))
        flat.extend(C[i,j] if i==j else 2*C[i,j] for i in range(M) for j in range(i,M))
        return fmpq_mat(self.coefficient_count,1,flat)

"""Exact/validated450-variable reduction of the source imaginary left-null system.

Matrix arguments use a common FLINT fmpq_mat or arb_mat backend. The inverse
is DEFINED from an actual selected master minor. No approximate left inverse
or orthogonal-projector assumption is accepted.
"""


def _matrix_like(reference,rows,cols,entries=None):
    cls=type(reference)
    return cls(rows,cols) if entries is None else cls(rows,cols,entries)


def _identity(reference,size):
    return _matrix_like(reference,size,size,[int(i==j) for i in range(size) for j in range(size)])


def _columns(matrix,start,stop):
    return _matrix_like(matrix,matrix.nrows(),stop-start,
        [matrix[i,j] for i in range(matrix.nrows()) for j in range(start,stop)])


class ImaginaryRankResidual:
    """Construct the COMPLETE residual map from untransformed J columns.

    master_blocks[j] is50×19 with column order even2..18, odd1..19.
    T is the exact sine matrix. selector_rows[j] selects19 monomial rows;
    source choice0..18 corresponds to powers1..19. All50 transformed
    membership rows are retained, including19 algebraically exact zeros.
    """
    def __init__(self,master_blocks,T,even_count,selector_rows=None,selector_row_powers=None,progress=None):
        self.J=list(master_blocks);self.T=T;self.M=T.nrows();self.e=int(even_count)
        if T.ncols()!=self.M or len(self.J)!=self.M:raise ValueError('Square phase matrix and one master block per source node required')
        if not self.J:raise ValueError('Nonempty master blocks required')
        self.r=self.J[0].ncols();self.o=self.r-self.e
        if not 0<self.e<self.r<=self.M:raise ValueError('Nonempty even/odd columns with independent local capacity required')
        if any(type(J)!=type(T) or J.nrows()!=self.M or J.ncols()!=self.r for J in self.J):
            raise ValueError('All master blocks must have matching backend and dimensions')
        self.selectors=([list(range(self.r)) for _ in self.J] if selector_rows is None else [list(v) for v in selector_rows])
        self.powers=([[0]*self.r for _ in self.J] if selector_row_powers is None else [list(v) for v in selector_row_powers])
        if len(self.selectors)!=self.M or len(self.powers)!=self.M:raise ValueError('One selector/scaling record per node required')
        for rows,powers in zip(self.selectors,self.powers):
            if len(rows)!=self.r or len(set(rows))!=self.r or any(not isinstance(i,int) or not 0<=i<self.M for i in rows):
                raise ValueError('Every selector must contain exactlyr distinct valid monomial rows')
            if len(powers)!=self.r or any(not isinstance(i,int) for i in powers):raise ValueError('Integer dyadic row exponents required')
        self.TT=T.transpose();self.TinvT=self.TT.inv();self.A=[];self.E=[];self.O=[]
        self.membership=[];self.signed=[];self.inverse_checks=[]
        eye=_identity(T,self.M);zero=T[0,0]*0;one=zero+1
        for node,(J,rows,powers) in enumerate(zip(self.J,self.selectors,self.powers)):
            # D is exactdyadic. A=(D S J)^-1 D S has the same exact left
            # inverse definition as(SJ)^-1S; D only conditions this inversion.
            scales=[one*(1<<p) if p>=0 else one/(1<<(-p)) for p in powers]
            minor=_matrix_like(T,self.r,self.r,[scales[i]*J[row,k] for i,row in enumerate(rows) for k in range(self.r)])
            inverse=minor.inv() # fmpq exact; Arb defaultvalidated, neverapprox.
            A=_matrix_like(T,self.r,self.M)
            for i in range(self.r):
                for k,row in enumerate(rows):A[i,row]=inverse[i,k]*scales[k]
            check=A*J
            good=all((check[i,k].contains(int(i==k)) if hasattr(check[i,k],'contains') else check[i,k]==int(i==k))
                for i in range(self.r) for k in range(self.r))
            if not good:raise ArithmeticError('Local inverse product sanity check failed')
            W=self.TinvT*J;E=_columns(W,0,self.e);O=_columns(W,self.e,self.r)
            membership=(eye-J*A)*self.TT
            # These rows vanish by S(I−J(SJ)^-1S)=0. They are exact
            # identities, not rounded residuals selected by a threshold.
            for row in rows:
                for k in range(self.M):membership[row,k]=zero
            signedW=_matrix_like(T,self.M,self.r,
                [W[i,k] if k<self.e else -W[i,k] for i in range(self.M) for k in range(self.r)])
            signed=signedW*A*self.TT
            self.A.append(A);self.E.append(E);self.O.append(O);self.membership.append(membership);self.signed.append(signed)
            self.inverse_checks.append(dict(node=node,selector_rows=rows,dyadic_row_powers=powers,
                inverse_defined_from_selected_minor=True,product_identity_enclosed_or_exact=True))
            if progress is not None:
                progress(node,self,dict(minor=minor,inverse=inverse,row_scales=scales))
        self.sym_pairs=[(i,j) for i in range(self.M) for j in range(i,self.M)]
        self.columns=self.M*self.e;self.rows=self.M*self.M+len(self.sym_pairs)
        self.exact_zero_rows=[j*self.M+i for j,rows in enumerate(self.selectors) for i in rows]
        self.metadata=dict(source_node_count=self.M,even_dimension=self.e,odd_dimension=self.o,
            unknown_count=self.columns,full_residual_row_count=self.rows,
            exactly_zero_membership_rows=self.exact_zero_rows,active_row_count=self.rows-len(self.exact_zero_rows),
            membership='(I−J_j A_j) T^T P^T[:,j], retaining allM rows',
            left_inverse='A_j=(D_j S_j J_j)^−1 D_j S_j; L_j=A_j T^T, hence L_j(T^−T J_j)=I',
            symmetry='Uppertriangle entries ofSym(Q−R), unweighted; offdiagonals include1/2, notsqrt2',
            transpose='Ordinary transpose in original congruence P/Q/R coordinates',
            variable_order='node-major even weights; alpha[j*even_dimension+a]',
            approximate_left_inverse_used_as_model=False,numerical_rank_truncation=False)

    def row(self,index):
        """Assemble one exact/enclosed row without constructing the whole map."""
        if not isinstance(index,int) or not 0<=index<self.rows:raise ValueError('Residual row index out of range')
        if index<self.M*self.M:
            node,component=divmod(index,self.M)
            return [self.membership[node][component,k]*self.E[k][node,a]
                    for k in range(self.M) for a in range(self.e)]
        i,j=self.sym_pairs[index-self.M*self.M]
        if i==j:
            return [-3*self.signed[j][j,k]*self.E[k][j,a]
                    for k in range(self.M) for a in range(self.e)]
        return [-3*(self.signed[j][i,k]*self.E[k][j,a]+self.signed[i][j,k]*self.E[k][i,a])/2
                for k in range(self.M) for a in range(self.e)]

    def matrix(self,row_indices=None):
        """Materialize requested rows; selecting a minor never changes fullmap."""
        indices=list(range(self.rows)) if row_indices is None else list(row_indices)
        return _matrix_like(self.T,len(indices),self.columns,[v for i in indices for v in self.row(i)])

    def recover(self,alpha):
        """Recover P,Q,R and every full residual for one candidate alpha."""
        if alpha.nrows()!=self.columns or alpha.ncols()!=1 or type(alpha)!=type(self.T):
            raise ValueError('A matching backend column of all even weights is required')
        P=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,self.M);Q=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,self.M);R=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,self.M)
        residual=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,self.M);weights=[];zero=self.T[0,0]*0
        for j in range(self.M):
            a=_matrix_like(self.T,self.e,1,[alpha[j*self.e+k,0] for k in range(self.e)])
            column=self.E[j]*a
            for i in range(self.M):P[i,j]=column[i,0]
        for j in range(self.M):
            t=_matrix_like(self.T,self.M,1,[P[j,i] for i in range(self.M)])
            z=self.A[j]*self.TT*t
            even=_matrix_like(self.T,self.e,1,[-3*z[k,0] for k in range(self.e)])
            odd=_matrix_like(self.T,self.o,1,[-3*z[self.e+k,0] for k in range(self.o)])
            qc=self.E[j]*even;rc=self.O[j]*odd;res=self.membership[j]*t
            for i in range(self.M):Q[i,j]=qc[i,0];R[i,j]=rc[i,0];residual[i,j]=res[i,0]
            for i in self.selectors[j]:residual[i,j]=zero
            weights.append((even,odd))
        S=(Q-R+(Q-R).transpose())/2
        vector=_matrix_like(self.T,self.rows,1,
            [residual[i,j] for j in range(self.M) for i in range(self.M)]+[S[i,j] for i,j in self.sym_pairs])
        return dict(P=P,Q=Q,R=R,membership=residual,symmetry=S,residual_vector=vector,recovered_weights=weights)
